blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — The Sangguniang Bayan of Paete has demanded a correction and a public “clarification” from GMA Network’s “Kapuso Mo, Jessica Soho “over a Halloween feature that allegedly linked the town’s centuries-old woodcarving tradition to curses and demonic forces. However, the program has since apologized, saying it did not intend to undermine the reputation, livelihood, and cultural heritage of Paete’s woodcarvers. In Resolution No. 166, Series of 2026, unanimously approved during its regular session on Nov. 3, the municipal council called on the network and the program’s production team to address concerns over the segment titled “Ukit,” which aired as […]...
